name: video-gaga
description: Agent skill: design motion-graphics videos in HTML Canvas (and three.js) and render them to MP4, with a generated beat-synced score, sound effects, Edge TTS narration and subtitles.
author: Chris Han <chris.han@castlery.org>

scripts.examples: for p in launch-keynote studio-3d clear-explainer blueprint data-globe editorial paper-sketch neon-circuit pop-collage pixel-retro cinematic-film; do node scripts/cv.mjs render presets/$p --subs burn || exit 1; done && node scripts/cv.mjs render presets/swiss-kinetic --motion-blur 5 && node scripts/cv.mjs render presets/ink-wash
